chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Ibn Muskan, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Three [types of people] to whom Allah will neither speak nor purify, and for them is a painful punishment — from them is the woman who tramples the bed of her husband.

key_terms.تُوطِئُ فِرَاشَ زَوْجِهَا: She tramples the bed of her husband (commits adultery)

ai.seo_question: Who are the three people Allah will not speak to or purify according to this hadith?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) to highlight the severe spiritual consequences of marital infidelity, specifically noting the woman who 'tramples her husband's bed' as a primary example of those denied divine speech and purification. This emphasizes the unique gravity of betraying the marital covenant, a theme central to Shia ethical jurisprudence regarding family integrity.
